class_b.root_cause: Architectural, not wording. pendingAction.actionType is typed archive|restore|null, so a clarification about an ASSIGN has no representable value and is necessarily emitted absent. Both deterministic-execution call sites then resolved the mutation field as CLARIFICATION_ENTITY_ACTION_FIELD[entityType]?.[actionType || 'archive'] - coercing an ABSENT action type into the most destructive operation available for that entity type. A bare 'yes' passes isClarificationAffirmative(), and commandContradictsActionType() cannot help because 'yes' contains neither verb family.
class_b.fix: Single fail-closed resolveClarificationField(entityType, actionType) helper: both must be explicitly present and known, otherwise it returns undefined and the turn falls through to the ordinary LLM path instead of mutating. Replaces both vulnerable call sites. Legitimate archive/restore confirmations set actionType explicitly and are unaffected.

classes_a_c_d_e.title: Same-channel history loss, stale grounding, false execution claims, channel identity regression
honesty_notes: 401 of 428 lifetime work_orders rows have channel_id IS NULL, but these are LEGACY (pre-2026-08-31, before channel binding shipped). Every turn on 8-31 carried a real channel_id. NOT the cause of current history loss.
The longest real production channel to date is 7 turns - just under the limit(8) window - so this truncation has never actually fired in production. It is guaranteed to at 50+ turns.

A harness bug was caught and fixed during authoring: Postgres now() is transaction-stable, so all inserted rows shared a created_at and order-by-created_at returned an arbitrary 8, producing a false PASS at the 200-turn scale. created_at is now set explicitly per turn; all three scales are consistent.
classes_a_c_d_e.required_future_design: structured channel_state with source_turn_id, pending action, action type, canonical target IDs, expected confirmation, expiry, session/channel binding, recent typed focus, last successful mutation, compaction-safe summary. Needs a new migration; not designed or authorized.
